description: A floor-length dark green Battanian court gown over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, naturally fitted opaque bodice and elbow sleeves. Gold knotwork woven bands frame the neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. A dark plaid wool shawl with fringed edges rests along her arms and is held by a small bronze shoulder brooch. A decorated woven belt, modest below-knee walking opening and brown leather shoes complete the outfit.
